subject: maths
question: Selling price of an article is Rs. 616. If loss percentage is 30 percent. then what Is the cost price of article?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (S.P) = Rs.616

Loss % = 30%

**Formula used:**

S.P = Cost price (C.P) × (100 - L)%

**Calculation:**

S.P = C.P × (100 - L)%

⇒ 616 = C.P × (100 - 30)%

⇒ 616 = C.P × 70 %

⇒ C.P = (616 × 100)/70

⇒ C.P = Rs.880

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.880.**
